lines.en: Now that I have expelled my demons, I am free to roam these sands undisturbed. Or at least until something else haunts me along the way.
Most of the girls have already gone back to their rooms. I heard their chatter as I slithered through the halls on the way outside.
But somewhat surprisingly, it seems as if they’ve given up on coming to find me after the initial excitement wore off.
Perhaps I’m just boring now. Or perhaps they’re afraid of what they’ll find.
Hell, I’d say it’s even possible at this point that they’ve come to some sort of formal agreement to stop pursuing my penis all together after a certain time during beach trips from now on.
If that’s the case, I am glad to have exhausted myself so early.
I am not glad, however, that just minutes after mentioning that I am free to roam the sands undisturbed, I have already encountered my first ghost.
And here I was thinking that I wouldn’t come across her — and that our awkward conversation through text would fade into the ether with the remnants of my forced optimism.
I could just turn around and leave.
But I suppose I also could have sodomized her right there in the karaoke booth and been in essentially the same situation now that someone handed her an excuse on a silver platter.
It was the last thing she needed, but the first thing she used. And of course I will once again reap the benefits of that. And the two of us will make up.
And slowly, over time, she will become less perturbed by the man I am and more likely to welcome me in ways she’ll neglect to ever tell her parents.
And I hate it.
I despise it.
I have won a battle I conceded. One I left behind. But someone went in and redacted the loss and now we’re right back at the start.
So I suppose it’s time to begin again then. Approach her and work my way back up — but it’s not like I’ll have to work very hard.
She will sing for me whether she likes it or not.
And I will mimic her cries the way this family of marsh warblers does.
For that is the only way we can ever feel like we fit in.
: Hey, Senpai! I thought I heard somebody sneaking up on us back there. Was worried for a second that all those Belarusian assassins were hot on my trail again.
: They are — and I am one of them. After all these years, I have finally obtained enough information to confirm that I am, in fact, going to kill you now.
: Please, Senpai! At least spare my child! I swear that she is innocent and does not deserve the same fate as me!
: At least not yet, she doesn’t! But who knows what will happen once her mother is taken back to Belarus!
: You’ve never even been to Belarus...have you, Miss Imai?
: I ain’t gonna lie to you, Karin. I probably couldn’t even point it out on a map.
: But you didn’t hear that from me since I feel like it’s only a matter of time until they add geography to the curriculum and I ain’t trying to lose my job.
: Speaking of which — good job so far, but you’re fired.
: Damn it! This is all Karin’s fault, isn’t it?!
: Just part of the assassination contract, unfortunately. Karin is now and always will be innocent.
: That said, though...can I make a request, Imani?
: Jeez, Senpai. Right in front of my daughter? Isn’t that a little forward?
: I was actually wondering if I could talk to your daughter. Alone.
: ...What?
: In the middle of the night? Why? We were just about to head back to the inn.
: I actually...asked Sensei if he could talk to me in private. It’s...something to do with my parents. He met them back when he used to...coach the soccer team.
: Huh...
: How come you’ve never mentioned that before, Senpai?
: Probably because Karin’s parents aren’t a very interesting or relevant conversation topic.
: Well, just...don’t keep her out too late, you hear? This girl needs her beauty sleep or you’ll be potentially interfering with the body of a future Olympian.
: Oh, stop...I’m not nearly that good at anything.
: Either way, uh...call me if you need me. Okay?
: I...left my phone in the room.
: Then yell very loudly.
: G’night, you two! Don’t stay out too- oh. I already said that, didn’t I?
: Bye!
: I didn’t expect you to lie for me back there, Karin. In fact, I didn’t realize you even could.
: It’s not like you left me much of a choice, Sensei.
: Imani’s obviously going to think something is weird if you ask to be alone with me in the middle of the night. Not every teacher is as...open to doing that as you.
: Just doing what you asked of me, Karin. You’re the one who wanted to talk again. And you said yourself that you wouldn’t be able to approach me.
: Yes, but couldn’t you have approached me during the day instead? That’d be way less suspicious.
: I was busy...sorry.
: Yeah, so was Kirin. I wonder if that’s a coincidence.
: Having buyer’s remorse already? Wish you never texted me at all?
: I wish I never met you at all.
: But only...
: Only because things were so much easier before I knew you.
: Well...can’t say I don’t agree with that. Sorry about the Olympics.
: I...I’m obviously not talking about the Olympics! I’m talking about how you make me feel...weird! And not the good kind of weird either! The mostly bad kind!
: Which...isn’t to say there’s never been any of the good kind! But I still don’t really understand what the good kind is and I sure as heck don’t think that any of this is-
: Karin, I get it. You don’t need to try and explain your position to me when I’m the one who put you there, remember? I know where you stand better than anyone.
: Then...
: Then would you mind telling me? Because I really can’t figure out what I’m supposed to do with you now...
: That makes it sound like I’m some kind of tool. Which I won’t outright deny — I just didn’t expect to hear it from you.
: I’m not calling you a tool...I’m saying that if what you did really was out of your control...isn’t it wrong for me to hold that against you? Or am I just acting crazy?
: The thing is, Karin...even if that was out of my control...
: It was born from somewhere real. And I doubt it would’ve happened if I hadn’t felt a certain explicit way about you.
: And that’s supposed to make me feel better? You’re really bad at this.
: I’m bad at it because I’m specifically not trying to make you feel better. But yeah. I guess I’d still probably suck at it even if I was.
: How do you feel now then? Do you think it might happen again?
: If it does, what will you do?
: The same move I defeated you with in Miss Osaka’s class, obviously. I know your weakness now.
: I’ve never been happier to be threatened with violence before.
: If it is what must be done, then it will be done.
We walk for a little while longer, awkwardly bantering about how awkward it is to be awkwardly bantering with one another after so much radio silence.
Not much has changed on Karin’s end. She’s still faithful, family-oriented, and so kind that I can’t help but be suspicious of her.
But everything has changed with me.
Well...maybe not everything. I still want to fuck her. I still want to not want to fuck her. And I’m still fucking myself by entering another scenario that can only end in one of two ways.
Either I come out on top, or she does. Either way, I’ll get my rocks off. And either way, she’ll succumb to the same divine hypnotism that compels everyone else to sleep with me.
That’s the only explanation after all. There’s no conceivable way all of these girls of different shapes and different sizes, treading all sorts of walks of life would somehow find their way to me.
: Have things gotten any better for you at home?
: Did you talk to Ami?
: A little...but she’s been kind of candid about your situation lately, so...all I really know is she’s going to come home.
: Then you should know that’s all I wanted in the first place. I’m kind of a mess without her.
: That’s like me with Kirin. I can’t rest when she’s not around. Like...I don’t even like her staying at the dorms.
: It’s the same with you, I’m guessing. Just...constant worrying about what she’s doing...if she’s safe. What her plans are.
: You might not be a good person, Sensei...but you’re definitely a good dad. Ami wouldn’t love you so much if that weren’t the case.
: Ami loves me because she’s conditioned to love me, not because I’ve earned it.
: If I was a good father, I’d have called myself that years ago. Not waited until she was on the verge of shattering to step into the role.
: To me, it matters less what the role is called and more just whether or not you’ve been there for her. I’m sure Ami would agree with that too.
: Ami would agree with anything that makes me look and sound better because she thinks it’s her purpose in life to just make my life easier when all I really want is for her to be happy.
: See? That’s exactly what you should be saying. And why I can still convince myself you’re a good guy even though you almost raped me in a karaoke booth.
: Karin-
: That’s the only time I’ll ever call it that because I know things are a little more complicated and, frankly, I just don’t like using icky words like that to begin with.
: But in my head, that’s what I thought was going to happen. And I need to say it out loud if I’m ever going to try and move past it. Which I want to.
: I forgive you, Sensei. And I won’t prevent you from actively participating in my life anymore should you ever want to.
: You can thank Touka for that, though. If she’d never told me about your “black out” things, I probably would have abhorred you forever.
: Karin...I’m still attracted to you. You know what that means.
: I do. Of course I do.
: But I also know that you’d change that about yourself if you could. And recognizing that you have a problem is the first step to ultimately correcting it.
: You’re ignoring a lot of red flags to say this, Karin...You don’t know how I am with other girls like you.
: You’re right. And I don’t really want to either since I’ve learned recently that I can’t function properly when I can only see the bad in people.
: You can call me delusional if you like. Or maybe naive or something. And honestly, I don’t think you’d be far off in saying that since I lie to myself sometimes for the sake of my happiness too.
: That’s why I can still smile when I see my sister even though I know she doesn’t love me.
: It’s why I can still hug my mom and my dad when I know I’m unfairly favored.

: It’s why I can gleefully ignore all of the girls at school who tease me about how I’ve never kissed a boy when I have one in mind that I’ve thought about doing that with more times than I can count.
: I don’t think it’s wrong to make your own happiness when the world won’t offer you any, though. So I’m okay with this delusional life so long as it keeps the color from fading.
: And I’m okay being the liar you’ve never imagined me to be since it’s that endless stream of little lies that stave off the bigger ones that people like you need to tell themselves.
: When you say you forgive me-
: That too could just be something I’m just telling myself to maintain a happy life.
: And I just have to live with the perpetual skepticism of that?
: Not if you lie to yourself too...and just assume that I’m telling the truth.
: Does it really matter in the end so long as we can smile beside each other?
: What’s the matter, Sensei? You’re looking all sad again.
: I am, but it’s not for myself.
: I’m sad because the thought of a girl like you, who brings joy to so many people, can even process such negative thoughts makes me hate this world we live in even more.
: How can anyone hate a world that has given them so many wonderful things?
: It’s easy to when it never hesitates to take them away.
: Even with that, I am still happy, Sensei.
: It’s just not all sunshine and smiles. Nobody’s that naive. And if you find someone who is, it’s always possible they’re just pretending to be.
: The main question now is where we go from here...
: And I guess also whether or not your attraction to me is powerful enough to spur a second attack.
: It’s always possible, Karin. I can’t rule it out and...I don’t want to ask you to trust me if there’s even the slightest chance that trust can be broken.
: Want to keep our distance then? Because, I don’t know about you, but I don’t particularly enjoy this. Avoiding people isn’t really my style.
: I...want to do whatever is best for you.
: So you’ll do as I say then? Maybe follow my lead for once instead of convincing me to just follow you around again.
: If you don’t want to avoid me anymore...then I will tear you away from Imani as many times as I need to.
: Even if it’s in the middle of the night?
: Even if it’s in the middle of the night.
: Then...
: I guess this is where we reset.
Karin walks back to the inn before me, leaving me there to stare out at the water and ponder once more about whether I am blessed or cursed.
Sometimes, it feels like both at once.
Meanwhile...miles away from here...
: ...and in Kumon-mi, we have a 30%% chance of rain tomorrow at 1:00 PM, with scattered showers forecasted to appear at 9:00 PM and continue throughout the night.
: You are happy here. There is no reason for you to ever leave. The world outside is dark and dreary and it is there where you will hurt the most.
: But in other, brighter news — the renovations at the Kumon-mi Mall are finally wrapping up!
: Shoppers can expect brand new retailers and restaurants from familiar names like the Produce Delivery Administration, Shiawase Group, and even Chipotle!
: Finally, we can call this place a real city.
: More like a real fucking piece of shit. I hope this place and the rest of the world burns to the ground and leaves no one alive.
: Oooookay. Note to self — don’t try to start conversations with strangers at the bar anymore.
: Hah...sorry. You didn’t do anything wrong. I just fucking hate men.
: Well, if it makes you feel any better, I have sworn them off entirely and devoted myself to the wondrous religion of lesbianism.
: Sorry. Not interested.
: Not interested in what? I didn’t-
: Oh! No. I am not hitting on you.
: I am madly in love with a goth girl who would tie me down and pour candle wax all over me if I even thought of hitting on another girl. And I don’t mean that in the good way.
: If you say so.
: You know...you look kind of familiar. We haven’t met before, have we?
: Cliche line for someone who isn’t hitting on me. You done yet?
: Damn. Just what the hell did this guy do to you?
: Well! Since you asked, I might as well as just tell you everything!
: I feel as if I have just made a fatal error.
: Not as fatal as making a girl fall in love with you then running away and subsequently forcing her into a blood-sucking industry for the sole purpose of trying to piss you off!

: Then reuniting years later, taking her virginity, swearing to be with her forever, and inviting her to live with you so she can teach you how to be a fucking father just so you can turn around and go fuck her teenage little sister directly in front of her!
: Jesus Christ...And I thought my relationship was having a rough patch.
: I fucking hate men! Anyone else in the entire fucking world would be thrilled to have me! But the one person I love winds up being a god damn creepy-ass sister-fucking predator!
: The fuck did I do to deserve this?!
: I’m not sure there’s anything a person can do to deserve that.
: But if it makes you feel better, I know a total of one man and he has also revealed to me recently that he’s a predator. So maybe they’re just all like that?
: Let’s kill them.
: I know k-
: With knives.
: I know karate.
: Knife karate...Good idea.
: Or just...regular karate.
: You’d be in favor of knife karate too if the guy you know fucked your teenage sister and made you listen to it for five fucking hours.
: Is that even possible? I didn’t think guys could last that long.
: Neither did I...
: Yikes...
: I swear...if he wasn’t the most fucking pathetic piece of shit on earth already, I would be destroying his entire fucking life right now.
: I mean...why don’t you? He sure as fuck deserves it.
: Well, why don’t you destroy the guy you know? Because I imagine he’s doing something just as fucked up if he decided to tell you about it.
: Well...I guess probably the same reason as you. I just feel bad for him.
: He’s always so sad and mopey and shit and...I do care about him. I just wish he...you know...didn’t suck.
: Fucking ridiculous. There are barely any men in this god damn fucking city and we’ve both managed to find the actual worst specimens possible.
: Yeah...
: That is...kind of...
: Oh no.
: WHAT’S YOUR GUY’S NAME?! SPIT IT OUT, LESBIAN!
: What’s your guy’s name?! I don’t want to go first!
: Akira!
: Fuck! It is the same guy!
: So he’s just telling people now?! Why didn’t you fucking warn me?!?!?!
: I’ve known you for three minutes!
: So what?! That’s no excuse! Unless he also neglected to tell you he was dating Niki fucking Nakayama! Which he probably did because he’s an asshole!
: I knew I recognized you from somewhere! You look so different without makeup!
: Yeah, kick me while I’m down, why don’t you?! It’s not enough that my boyfriend is fucking my sister and god knows who else! Now I need to get emotionally assaulted by a karate lesbian too!
: Listen, Niki — can I call you Niki? That’s not just a stage name, is it?
: Call me Patrice. It’ll help me maintain my current level of uninhibited fury.
: Then Patrice — we both know Akira is the scum of the earth, yeah? And that his inhibitions must be stopped by all means necessary-
: Knife karate it is...
: But we also know he is a fucking moron who doesn’t actually want to hurt you. So-
: So what, karate lesbian?! Who gives a shit about whether he wanted to hurt me or not! He hit me with the actual biggest betrayal possible! I literally can’t think of a worse one!
: I mean...you seem to really hate this Patrice girl, so-
: Don’t you even fucking joke about that, karate lesbian.
: Can you stop calling me “karate lesbian” please? My name is Osako.
: Sure thing, karate lesbian.
: You just did it again.
: Point is — there is only so much I can take. And even if he doesn’t want to hurt me, he did. Badly. And I’m not going to go crying back to him to fix that.
: Instead, I am going to give myself alcohol poisoning and die.
: That way, he will have to live with the regret of killing me and I will get to laugh at him from Heaven while HE FUCKS MY SISTER AGAIN!
: Do you...want me to talk to him? See if he’ll...come try and hash things out with you or something?
: Or should I maybe just order your next round once you finish with that one and contribute to your suicide fund?
: Is knife karate really out of the question?
: I am not quite sure that even exists.
: Do whatever you want. Just don’t fuck him. I need as many people on my side as I can get in this stupid fucking city.
: Yeah, I don’t think you’ll have to worry about that. Lesbian, remember? You’ve said it like fifty times tonight?
: Trust no one. Not even the gays. I am alone in this world.
: How about I just...pre-emptively buy the next round then?
: Thank you, karate lesbian...maybe you’re not so bad after all.
: It’s Osako. O-sa-ko. And if you maybe just want to, like...I don’t know...scribble that down on a napkin or something-
: Are you seriously asking me for an autograph NOW?! In the middle of my crisis?!
: Whaaaaaat? Noooo! I was just...you just keep calling me “karate lesbian” and...you know...maybe a little practice would-
: JUST GET ME A FUCKING BEER! JESUS CHRIST!
Karin’s affection has increased to [karin_love]!
Niki and Osako grew in a slightly more depressing and complex way!
